text:
maya: Quick sync: micro launch plan for community dev content next week. Deliverables: 3 short how-to tutorials, 1 small open-source refapp repo, a 20-min mini webinar, and a punchy benchmark stat for social. Owners?
sam: I can handle webinar logistics + CTAs. Proposed: Wed 10am PT. :calendar: 
jordan: I'll own tutorials + refapp. Topics: chat integration, embeddings search, and a cost-saving serving pattern. Need perf numbers for the benchmark blurb; @kyle can you run parity tests vs hosted and dedicated?
kyle: Yep. Running perf matrix today. I'll output p50/p95, throughput, and cost per 1M tokens. Using command:
```bash
./bench_tool --model redwood-3b --env dedicated --batch 8 --seq 512 --out bench.json
```
olga: Ill design hero + tweet cards. Need final single stat by Tues noon. Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/quickstart-kits
maya: Messaging angle suggestion: "Start shipping LLM features with predictable costs and production-grade latency." Open to edits.
sam: Benchmark narrative should highlight real dev flows: chat latency (with/without caching) and embeddings rerank cost. Show cost per 1M tokens to make tradeoffs tangible.
jordan: Webinar format: 20-min demo + 10-min live Q&A. I'll draft script and pick 3 questions. Need demo snippets from @kyle (cache/no-cache).
kyle: Posting early numbers: p95(dedicated)=130ms, p95(hosted)=170ms. Estimated cost per 1M tokens: dedicated ~$1,150, hosted ~$1,700 (with conservative batching). Will refine.
analytics-bot: Funnel test created: /signup?utm_campaign=quickstart-launch&utm_source=twitter&utm_medium=social
maya: Inbound lead routing: @sam please wire SFDC sandbox webhook. Mapping: utm_campaign=quickstart-launch, lead_owner=marketing_queue. Example curl:
```bash
curl -X POST https://hooks.sfdc.sandbox/api/leads -d '{"utm_campaign":"quickstart-launch","source":"twitter","email":"{{email}}"}'
```
sam: I'll set utms and auto-assign rule. Also add a thank-you email with next steps.
olga: Draft hero comps by Tues EOD; need primary stat from @kyle to lock copy.
kyle: Final numbers posted: p95(dedicated)=125ms, p95(hosted)=168ms, cost/1M tokens: dedicated ~$1,120 vs hosted ~$1,690. Use the p95 delta (~43ms) as social stat.
maya: Thanks everyone. I'll drop draft launch post and X thread Tue 9am, plus a 300-word blog outline. :rocket:
